title: Resonance Raman Study of a High-valent Fe=O Porphyrin Complex as a Model for Peroxidase Compound II
abstract: Abstract                Resonance Raman spectroscopy is applied to a FeIV oxo porphyrin with imidazolate as the axial ligand. The νFe=O mode is observed at 792 cm−1, which is 23 cm−1 lower than that of the analogous 1–methylimidazole complex and similar to that of horseradish peroxidase compound II (787 cm−1) at alkaline pH, for which presence of an anionic histidine was previously postulated. This study thus provides a useful model compound of horseradish peroxidase compound II.
